objective: Tranche 1b2: upstream provenance verification, the release registry, and calix-daemon serving the unified inventory over a Unix socket.

steps.name: provenance-module
steps.detail: shared/provenance.zig: parse a forge's digest (api field, bare hex, coreutils sums line), hash and compare a file, select a checksum asset, and carry a Trust level whose describe() states what the check does and does not prove.

steps.name: provenance-wired-into-apply
steps.detail: appimage/update_manager.zig verifies the downloaded artefact before the swap. A published digest that does not match refuses the update and changes nothing; an absent digest is reported as unverified rather than silently accepted. The verified message names the digest and whether it came from release metadata or a checksum file.

steps.name: release-registry
steps.detail: release/registry.zig: JSON state in the daemon's state directory. record() answers 'is there news?' and never marks anything told; markNotified() is called only after the notification happened. A forge rolling back to a prerelease is not news (release_version.isNewer). Atomic save via a flushed sibling and rename.

steps.name: inventory-service-extraction
steps.detail: The gathering moved out of commands/inventory.zig into inventory/service.zig so the CLI and the daemon serve one implementation rather than two that drift.

steps.name: calix-daemon
steps.detail: New executable: JSON-lines protocol over a Unix socket ($XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/calix/daemon.sock), actions ping/status/inventory/releases/mark-notified, protocol version checked before dispatch, one-request arena, per-day operational journal in the state directory, stale-socket detection. Built by the same backend library as the CLI.

steps.name: live-daemon-smoke
steps.detail: Ran the built binary against a temporary socket and state directory.

observed.generated_at: wall clock (verified against the host date)
observed.releases: GitHub Copilot probed via static_url, recorded in releases.json
observed.mark_notified: persisted; after a daemon restart the same version reports is_news=false
observed.journal: daemon-2026-10-20.jsonl, one JSON object per event

steps.name: full-test-suites
steps.detail: PackageManager 1382 passed / 4 skipped; CLI 387 passed; UI (cargo) 195 passed.

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: The response envelope's closing brace was lost while the writer block was assembled; every response was truncated JSON.
defects_found_and_fixed.caught_by: live socket smoke test, not by unit tests

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Timestamps used std.Io.Timestamp.now(io, .awake), which is monotonic since boot: status reported started_at=226883 and the journal dated itself in 1970.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: .real for wall-clock fields; uptime measured monotonically so a clock jump cannot make it negative

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Server.init freed the journal's directory string on return, so the journal appended to freed memory and silently wrote nothing.
defects_found_and_fixed.caught_by: live socket smoke test (no journal file appeared)
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the journal owns its directory; deinit frees it

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Month.jan is 1, not 0; adding one to @intFromEnum shifted every journal file a month, and the test that read the file back failed with FileNotFound.
A test used /proc as an unwritable directory and hung the suite at 100% CPU instead of failing.
defects_found_and_fixed.caught_by: the test suite timing out; bisected by running the module test binary and reading the last line it printed
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: use a regular file as a parent directory: NotDir, immediately

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: Adding a second test artifact for the daemon re-ran the whole CLI suite in parallel with itself, contending for the same on-disk fixtures.
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: removed the duplicate artifact; the daemon's tests are reachable from src/root.zig

incident.summary: Zig 0.17.0 replaced 0.16.0 as /usr/bin/zig during the session. Every build then failed with 'no field named args in struct Build' — in this repository and in vendored dependency build scripts alike.
incident.detection: zig version reported 0.17.0; /usr/bin/zig mtime matched the change
incident.resolution: Extracted the cached zig-0.16.0-1.1 package into vendor/zig-0.16 with bsdtar (no root, no package-manager change) and built with that binary. vendor/ added to .gitignore.
incident.note: The system default remains 0.17.0. The repository targets 0.16.0; nothing in this tranche was validated against 0.17.

known_gaps: The GPUI frontend still reads the Python-written state files through calix_state.rs. The daemon serves the inventory, but nothing in the product consumes it yet; the cutover is the next slice.
The apply flow (bump PKGBUILD, makepkg, root helper, rollback) is not implemented. Provenance is wired into the AppImage update path, which is user-scoped, not root.
No root helper binary and no polkit rule yet.
A .static_url AppImage is recorded against its ETag token, which is the existing prober's idea of a version; is_news therefore fires once per ETag change.
The daemon serves connections one at a time. Correct, and the stated trade-off, but unmeasured under concurrent clients.
